# LocalCloud

LocalCloud provides 27 available Google Cloud service guides in one local Docker runtime. Availability does not imply full Google Cloud parity or default startup. Firestore is available but disabled by default; Google Sheets provides a limited read-only values facade.

LocalCloud is not a production replacement. Use is governed by the proprietary LocalCloud license; review the license before use. The proprietary Community License permits royalty-free Community Use by individual developers, students, and nonprofit organizations; for-profit companies require a separate Commercial License. Excluded uses include for-profit company use without a separate Commercial License, work for a for-profit employer or client under the Community License, commercial product development without a Commercial License, business operations or team CI without a Commercial License.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://local.cloud/install.sh | sh
localcloud doctor
localcloud start
eval "$(localcloud env)"
localcloud console
```

## Runtime facts

- Default project: `local-gcp-project`
- Default user: `local-developer`
- Default data volume: `localcloud-data`
- CLI memory default: `4g`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/health`
- Shell environment endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/env?format=shell`
- Terraform environment endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/env?format=terraform`

Trust URLs and endpoint values returned by the selected CLI runtime; occupied canonical ports may be remapped. Select durable storage with `--data-volume NAME`; project and caller remain request context. LocalCloud emulates bounded local development workflows. Validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

## Useful URLs

- Service catalog: https://local.cloud/services/

- Pricing: https://local.cloud/pricing/
- Licensing: https://local.cloud/docs/licensing/
- LocalStack for Google Cloud: https://local.cloud/localstack-for-google-cloud/
- CLI releases: https://github.com/LocalGCloud/localcloud-cli/releases

## Services
- Cloud Storage — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :24081; `STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:24081`. Verified only for the documented bounded local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Pub/Sub — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24082; `PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24082`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Firestore — partial; available but disabled by default; gRPC :24083; `FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24083`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Bigtable — supported; starts by default; gRPC :24084; `BIGTABLE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24084`. Verified only for the documented bounded local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Spanner — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24085 · HTTP/REST :24086; `SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24085`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- BigQuery — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :24087 · gRPC :24088; `BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:24087`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Google Sheets — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :24080; `SHEETS_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Secret Manager — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24080; `SECRET_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Tasks — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24080; `CLOUD_TASKS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Scheduler — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24080; `CLOUD_SCHEDULER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Functions (2nd Gen) — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24080; `CLOUD_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- AlloyDB — partial; starts by default; gRPC :24080; `ALLOYDB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.

- Cloud Resource Manager — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :24080; `CLOUD_RESOURCE_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:24080`. Verified only for the documented bounded local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Service Usage — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :24080; `SERVICE_USAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Billing — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :24080; `CLOUD_BILLING_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:24080`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.

## Safety boundaries

- The mutable image identity is release-unverified; prefer the host CLI and pin a qualified digest for release work.
- Default CLI Docker-socket and transparent-network settings are off.
- Technical tiers and successful startup do not grant legal permission.
- Runtime telemetry and other outbound behaviors are documented at https://local.cloud/docs/privacy/.
- Validate allowed release behavior against real Google Cloud after clearing local endpoint variables.
